column4: hand per-site StepObs lemma: the region is on the block-reflection decode table — use #derive_case/block_facts (model: Vsa/Sim/EnvDefSeg.lean; 58 hand lines became 14)

maxHeartbeats above the 8000000 standard: a timeout means the construction is wrong — fix with more abstraction (check ground literals first), never a budget raise (values at or below the standard are fine)
hand ABI-frame threading: framed variants are FREE — use FrameMeta (abiFrame_of_wrChain / memFrame_of_chain / bblocks_sound_framed, one decide per block)
per-callee framed re-derivation: before re-running a chain with a ghost conjunct, check FrameMeta metatheorems apply (they subsume ABI + footprint frames)
>12 stepObs_ references in one new file: this is a hand-threaded chain — use the seg/block-reflection layer (block_facts, #derive_case, chain_facts)

deep anonymous projection (4+ chain) into an ∃/∧ tower: state posts/entries as named-field `structure ... : Prop where` (model: FoundSt/GeomFacts/FrameCalc), or land ONE named destructuring lemma beside the landed tower and consume through it — never positional .2-chains

>8 existentials in one file suggests anonymous ∃/∧-tower post definitions: new posts/entries must be named-field structures (robust to reorder, self-documenting, cheap projections); if consuming landed towers, write the named destructurer once
conseq with an identity side: use Triple.dimap/lmap/rmap (TripleCat) — the profunctor action is the canonical adapter; adapter PAIRS should be one PredIso + transportPre/transportPost
